fen.meet.speaker: fen
lines: I thought I was the only soul on this road!

fen.startled.speaker: fen
lines: Forgive me. You learn to hide out here.
Fen, by the way. Just Fen.

fen.ask.3.speaker: fen
lines: It's good to hear a human voice again.

fen.ask.5.speaker: fen
lines: How in the world did you get out?

fen.ask.9.speaker: fen
lines: Ha! I suppose that explains the smoke.
You picked a strange road to wander.
These woods are beautiful, aren't they?

fen.ask.11.speaker: fen
lines: Aye. But don't let that fool you.
There are thieves on the western roads.
And things in the old ruins...

fen.boars.speaker: fen
lines: Boars are the least of it, friend.

fen.aether.5.speaker: fen
lines: Is that what Ferrum teaches now?

fen.aether.7.speaker: fen
lines: Then how did you wake that stone?

fen.aether.9.speaker: fen
lines: There's a great deal you don't know yet.
But that's what makes a journey worth taking.

fen.nothing.speaker: fen
lines: Crown ink, and a pencil line. Not nothing.

fen.signal.1.speaker: you
lines: Three short. Three long. Three short.

fen.signal.4.speaker: fen
lines: I've seen a light on the far hills.
Never knew what to make of it.

fen.signal.6.speaker: fen
lines: Then you'll want the river road.
It leads to a ford, farther west.
And beyond that, there are people.

fen.signal.10.speaker: fen
lines: Out here, a friendly face means more
than any fine coat or polished blade.

fen.end.2.speaker: fen
lines: May the old lights guide you, lad.

fen.repeat.speaker: fen
lines: The river road. West, to the ford.
Mind the thieves. And mind the ruins.
May the old lights guide you.
